name: Resample Test
description: Bootstrap confidence intervals and two-sample permutation tests computed in Java over at most max_rows rows. Bootstrap (mode bootstrap) resamples the observations with replacement and reports statistic, estimate, se, ci_low/ci_high (percentile, confidence), bias, n and resamples for mean, median, sd, correlation (two columns) or slope (OLS of the second column on the first). Permutation (mode permutation) shuffles the labels of group between the two levels of value and reports statistic, observed (difference of means or medians, first group minus second in sorted order), p_value (add-one estimator; alternative two-sided, less, greater), n and permutations. A seed makes every draw reproducible.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: bootstrap resamples rows with replacement; permutation shuffles the group labels of value.

statistic.title: Statistic
statistic.description: Statistic to resample: mean, median, sd, correlation, slope (bootstrap) or difference_mean, difference_median (permutation).

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: One numeric column for mean/median/sd, two for correlation/slope (first = x, second = y). Ignored in permutation mode.

value.title: Value column
value.description: Permutation: numeric column whose values are reshuffled between the two groups.

group.title: Group column
group.description: Permutation: categorical column with exactly two levels.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence level of the bootstrap interval, in (0, 1).

alternative.title: Alternative hypothesis
alternative.description: Tail used by the permutation p-value.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed of the random stream; the same seed gives the same numbers.

max_rows.title: Max rows
max_rows.description: The resampling runs in memory: at most this many rows are read.
